interpretation: retrospective final-price oracle on repeated 2026 development dates

selection_contract.gross_return: 1000 KRW * final displayed odds on exact event hit; else 0
selection_contract.candidate_tie_break: numeric event tuple ascending; preserve order for EXA/TRI
selection_contract.max_ev_tie_break: numeric event tuple ascending; preserve order for EXA/TRI

probability_source.operating: full native HY ordered Top3 joint; all matching order mass summed
probability_source.research_tla: independently audited F1_STYLE6 native unordered Top3 set probability

pool_definitions.QNL: official first and second horses, unordered pair
pool_definitions.EXA: official first then second, ordered pair
pool_definitions.TRI: official first, second, third in exact order

api301.price_timing: archived final post-race API301 odds; official publication timestamp unavailable

limits: Final prices are post-race values; EV/ROI are retrospective oracle scores, not pre-purchase evidence.
The shared cohort has been used repeatedly and is not independent future validation.
TRI excludes 245 races with at least one 9999.9 invalid-odds sentinel; no quote is imputed.
Other-pool research probabilities are unavailable except TLA; no rank or probability proxy is substituted.
Native model comparisons do not establish stable profit or a best post-race threshold.
